title: Civilisation Classes
description: This project adds "farming", "mining", "building", "exploring", and "combat" stats that can be leveled up but also forgotten if not practised.
body:
This datapack adds 5 skill areas to level up: Mining, Combat, Farming, Building, and Exploration. Upgrading skills will cause you to gain certain buffs. If you do not practise a skill enough you will forget it and it will decrease by 1 level. Adding this datapack to your server is a great way to make players naturally form civilisations as it is easier to form groups of specialised players than to individually try to fully upgrade every skill.

**Mining:**
Upgrading your Mining level will cause you to break certain blocks faster and take less fall damage.

**Combat:**
Upgrading your Combat level will allow you to reach entities from further away and do more damage.

**Farming:**
Upgrading your Farming level will allow you to break certain blocks faster and will give you a health boost.

**Building:**
Upgrading your Building level will allow you to place blocks further away and have decreased gravity.

**Exploration:**
Upgrading your Exploration level will let you move faster
